apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Create keys for MCP clients. Agency keys also work with the read-only public API. MCP can start audits and use your plan allowance, so keep each key secret.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.createDescription: Give the key a name so you can recognize it later — for example, the tool that will use it.
apiKeys.showOnceWarning: This is the only time we will show this key. Store it somewhere safe — you cannot see it again.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmDescription: “{{name}}” will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.upgradeHint: MCP access is available on Starter and above. Upgrade to connect an MCP client.
